title: Diagnostic Report: H&M Colombia (co.hm.com)
summary: H&M Colombia's site runs on VTEX FastStore/Next.js with ~970K monthly visits (96% Colombia). The catalog spans approximately 3,500 products across 7 sitemaps with strong structured data but faces significant performance issues (LCP 11-17s mobile), no editorial content engine, no customer reviews on sampled PDPs, and failed Next.js data requests degrading the user experience.
